title: 30s lifestyle stroll
prompt: A relaxed 30-second lifestyle stroll in G major at 105 BPM with a light swing, for a sunny everyday-product ad. It opens on a warm nylon-string strum of Gmaj9 at frame 0 with a soft kick and the bass. Two bars of Karplus-Strong fingerpicking follow through the sunny Gmaj9-Cmaj9-Em9-D6/9 loop. In bars 3-4 a round finger bass, a soft kick and lightly swung hats join. Bars 5-8 open up with a side-stick on 2 and 4, a swung shaker, a soft pad and a singing high-string melody. A three-beat turnaround bar (Am9 to D9sus) pushes and stops for a breath. The end tag then lands exactly on frame 600 (20.0 s): a bright Gmaj9 strum, kick, bass and a rising three-note motif. The groove thins out over three gentle bars, and a final Gmaj9 strum with a high echo of the motif rings out to silence. Only the kick and bass sit below 120 Hz, in mono. The bed is softly scooped around 2.5 kHz so a voiceover sits on top.
notes:
Warm nylon plucks are vectorised Karplus-Strong strings (3-tap damping low-pass convolved with a linear fractional delay, so a whole period is computed per numpy step) with a soft low-passed excitation, pluck-position comb and two body resonances; strums roll low-to-high with the first string exactly on the cue. Light 62 % swing on hats, shaker and picking; side-stick instead of claps; round finger bass and soft kick are the only content below 120 Hz, mono.
Arc: frame-0 Gmaj9 strum, two bars of solo fingerpicking (Gmaj9-Cmaj9-Em9-D6/9), bass/kick/hats from bar 3, side-stick, shaker, pad and high-string melody from bar 5, a 3-beat Am9-D9sus turnaround that stops for a 60 ms breath, then the end tag exactly on frame 600 (strum + rising B-D-G motif, the loudest moment), thinning to a final Gmaj9 strum with a high motif echo that rings out to silence.
Mastered with a 4x-oversampled look-ahead gain limiter iterated to -14 LUFS / -1.3 dBTP; guitar bus scooped -2.5 dB at 2.5 kHz for voiceover; residual DC removed with a sub-1 Hz Hann-shaped offset; TPDF-dithered to 16-bit. Deployed WAV is 32 kHz stereo (960000 frames) for the Workers 5 MiB cap; MP3 from the 48 kHz master.
